idiom_name: pub fn new_*(...) -> Result<Box<dyn Trait>, E>
implementation_notes: Rust has no inheritance, so 'let a subclass decide' becomes 'let the construction site decide the concrete type'; the polymorphic product is a trait object, and a free function returns Box<dyn Shape> - the vtable in the trait object supplies exactly the run-time dispatch the classic Creator override provided (doc.rust-lang.org, Returning Traits with dyn). Associated functions named new are the language convention for constructors, and because they are ordinary functions they can return Result and validate, which a struct literal cannot.
pitfalls: Box<dyn Trait> needs a dyn-compatible (object-safe) trait: generic methods and methods returning Self make the trait unusable as a trait object.
Trait objects are neither Send nor Sync unless the trait says so; a factory feeding a shared registry must return Box<dyn Trait + Send + Sync>.
An unknown kind should be a named error variant with context, not a boxed dyn Error stripped of the key that failed.
The `dyn` keyword is required from the 2018 edition; writing Box<Trait> was only valid in the 2015 edition.

variants.name: Enum variants plus match
variants.idiom_name: pub enum Shape { Circle { r: f64 }, Square { side: f64 } } + match
variants.implementation_notes: When the set of products is closed, idiomatic Rust prefers an enum whose variants carry each product's data and a match that constructs them: no heap allocation, no vtable, value semantics (Copy/PartialEq come for free) and exhaustiveness checking - the compiler rejects a non-exhaustive match when a variant is added (doc.rust-lang.org book, The match Control Flow Construct). Choose it over Box<dyn Trait> whenever no external crate must add a product.
pitfalls: An enum makes the product set closed: adding a variant is a breaking change for downstream matches, so mark a public enum #[non_exhaustive] if it may grow.
Every method must match on every variant, so behaviour shared by most variants tends to be duplicated unless a trait with default methods is also implemented for the enum.
Large variant payloads make the enum as big as its largest variant; box the heavy variants if values are moved in bulk.
